name: Claude Code on the web
summary: Run Claude Code tasks in the cloud from your browser, phone or terminal, and pick them up later.
what: Cloud sessions run Claude Code on a virtual machine managed by Anthropic instead of your computer. You start one at claude.ai/code, in the Claude mobile app or from the terminal, point it at a GitHub repository, and it keeps working after you close your laptop. When it's done you can review the changes, open a pull request, or bring the session into your terminal.

impact.title: Work keeps going without you
impact.detail: Start a task, close the laptop, and check the result later from any device.

impact.title: Several tasks at once
impact.detail: Run separate sessions in parallel, each in its own cloud machine.

impact.title: Move between cloud and terminal
impact.detail: Teleport a cloud session into your local terminal to continue it there.

howItWorks: Open claude.ai/code, connect GitHub, and pick a repository and an environment.
Or start from the terminal with claude --cloud "your task".
Each environment sets its network access, environment variables and setup script.
Bring a session to your terminal with claude --teleport or /teleport.
Needs a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or eligible Enterprise plan; it isn't available through third-party cloud providers.

events.note: First changelog mention of Claude Code on the web, with teleport from web to terminal.
Starting a message with & sends it to the web as a background task.
